blocks.text: The Lenovo Idea Tab Pro helps you tackle challenging assignments, jot down quick notes, and streamline your workload so you can focus on what matters. The 12.7” 3K LCD display is designed with a Low Blue Light hardware solution so that your eyes stay relaxed and comfortable while reading. Quad JBL® speakers optimized by Dolby Atmos® provide powerfully immersive sound to keep your vibe flowing all day long. The MediaTek Dimensity 8300 processor has the power to provide you with long lasting battery life and pairs with Wi-Fi 6E for swift downloads. The Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is perfect for heavy media use and can effortlessly stream movies and shows for over 11 hours unplugged. Say goodbye to translating apps; now when you see words in another language you can use Google’s Circle to Search to get help instantly. Whether it’s an image, video, or text, just long press the home button or navigation bar and tap the translate button to see instant translations. The Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is jam-packed with innovative features to help you learn like Google Gemini, an AI assistant to supercharge your ideas. Get help learning in new ways, writing thank you notes, planning events, and more. The included Lenovo Tab Pen Plus is perfect for effortlessly annotating class materials and video screenshots alike for a one-step study-guide. Create long-scroll notes from browsers and documents, then save as PDF or JPG. The sleek and lightweight Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is made for campus vibes and coffee-shop flexes. Get ready to learn!

NEXT-GEN PERFORMANCE – Perform at your best with the super-efficient MediaTek Dimensity 8300 processor. Supported by Wi-Fi-6E, get ready for smooth multitasking and lightning-quick downloads.

IMMERSIVE VISUALS AND RICH SOUND – Whether you’re streaming lectures or decompressing after class, the glittering 12.7” 3K LCD display supported by quad JBL Dolby Atmos speakers makes your media crystal clear.

GAME LIKE A PRO – Get ready to up your game; the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro is PUBG certified for FPS excellence. It’s kitted out with a super-responsive 360Hz touch sampling rate and lightning-fast 90fps so you’re always a step ahead of the action.
CHARGE LESS TO EXPERIENCE MORE – Leave battery-anxiety back at the dorm with 11 hours of unplugged video streaming. For long days out, the 45W quick charge gets you back in the action fast.
SUPERCHARGE YOUR STUDIES – Stuck on a late-night assignment. Let Google Gemini, an AI super-assistant pick your brain so you can get back to chasing your passion.

CIRCLE IT, SEARCH IT – Say goodbye to screenshots with Google’s Circle to Search feature. Press the home button, draw a circle on what you want to search with either your finger or the included Tab Pen Plus, and have your questions answered instantly.

FOCUSED READING NEVER FELT SO GOOD – Strain your brain, not your eyes by switching between mono and chromatic visual modes to suit any reading moment. The display is Low Blue Light certified to make studying comfortable anywhere.
